tokens.name: surface-0
tokens.usage: App/page background; chart surface.

tokens.name: surface-1
tokens.usage: Raised: cards, sheets, toasts, text fields, keypad keys.

tokens.name: surface-2
tokens.usage: Sunken fills: segmented track, chips at rest, skeletons, pressed rows.

tokens.name: ink-1
tokens.usage: Primary text and icons; hero amount; expense amounts; primary-button fill (label in surface-0).

tokens.name: ink-2
tokens.usage: Secondary text: merchant meta, labels, axis titles.

tokens.name: ink-3
tokens.usage: Muted text: captions, placeholders, tick labels, transfer amounts.

tokens.name: line
tokens.usage: Hairline dividers (1px) between rows and sections. Decorative only.

tokens.name: line-strong
tokens.usage: Boundaries that must be seen: text-field underline/border, chip outline, unchecked checkbox (>=3:1).

tokens.name: accent
tokens.usage: Deep green. Links, focus ring, selected segment/chip/month, active tab, checked checkbox. Never a button fill, a chart mark or an amount.

tokens.name: accent-ink
tokens.usage: Text and icons on the rare accent-filled element (a checked checkbox). Not used by buttons.

tokens.name: accent-soft
tokens.usage: Selection wash behind accent text (selected chip, selected month, selected category tile).

tokens.name: focus
tokens.usage: Keyboard focus ring: 2px solid, 2px offset in the surface color.

tokens.name: income
tokens.usage: Income amounts as text, always with a + sign. Leaf green, distinct from the bottle-green accent.

tokens.name: expense
tokens.usage: Expense amounts (= ink-1). Spending is the normal case, so it is never red.

tokens.name: transfer
tokens.usage: Transfer amounts (= ink-3), always with the arrow-left-right glyph and no sign.

tokens.name: person-a
tokens.usage: Person A ("Tú") on marks only: stacked-bar segment, 8px dot. Never text. = series-1.

tokens.name: person-b
tokens.usage: Person B ("{pareja}") on marks only. Never text. = series-2.

tokens.name: mark-neutral
tokens.usage: Single-series chart marks (spend by category, 6-month trend). Expense is ink, in charts too.

tokens.name: mark-muted
tokens.usage: De-emphasised marks: "Hogar/shared" segment, "Otros", previous period. Sub-3:1, so always labelled.

tokens.name: series-1
tokens.usage: Categorical slot 1 (blue).

tokens.name: series-2
tokens.usage: Categorical slot 2 (orange).

tokens.name: series-3
tokens.usage: Categorical slot 3 (aqua).

tokens.name: series-4
tokens.usage: Categorical slot 4 (yellow).

tokens.name: series-5
tokens.usage: Categorical slot 5 (magenta).

tokens.name: series-6
tokens.usage: Categorical slot 6 (bronze; replaces the reference green).

tokens.name: series-7
tokens.usage: Categorical slot 7 (violet).

tokens.name: series-8
tokens.usage: Categorical slot 8 (plum; replaces the reference red).

tokens.name: status-good
tokens.usage: Success icon (check-circle) + label. Never alone.

tokens.name: status-warning
tokens.usage: Warning icon (triangle-alert) + label; "dudosa" review rows.

tokens.name: status-serious
tokens.usage: Serious icon (octagon-alert) + label; budget over 90%.

tokens.name: status-critical
tokens.usage: Errors and destructive actions only: icon, field error text, destructive button text/border.

tokens.name: gridline
tokens.usage: Chart gridlines: 1px solid, recessive.

tokens.name: baseline
tokens.usage: Chart baseline/axis rule: 1px solid.

tokens.name: scrim
tokens.usage: Backdrop behind bottom sheets and dialogs.

groups.name: Numbers
groups.note: Hero amounts use proportional figures; every column of amounts uses tabular figures.

styles.name: display
styles.usage: The single hero amount per view. Proportional figures, range 40–48px.

styles.name: amount
styles.usage: Amounts in rows, tables and totals. Always tabular figures.

styles.name: title
styles.usage: Screen titles and stat-tile values (proportional figures).

styles.name: heading
styles.usage: Section, sheet and chart titles; empty-state titles.

styles.name: body
styles.usage: Running text, merchant names, field values.

styles.name: body-strong
styles.usage: Button labels and emphasis inside body.

styles.name: label
styles.usage: Field labels, chips, segmented options, legend items, day headers.

styles.name: eyebrow
styles.usage: Uppercase section label; one per section at most.

styles.name: caption
styles.usage: Row metadata, helper text, axis ticks, tab labels.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Icon-to-label gap, segmented inset.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Between related controls; grid gaps.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Side gutter, card padding, header-to-content.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Between groups inside a section.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Between sections on a scrolling screen.

tokens.name: space-12
tokens.usage: Empty-state breathing room.

tokens.name: row-height
tokens.usage: List rows, keypad keys, the bottom primary button.

tokens.name: tap-min
tokens.usage: Smallest hit area (icon buttons, chips via invisible padding).

tokens.name: tabbar-height
tokens.usage: Tab bar, plus the bottom safe-area inset.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Bar data-ends, badges, checkboxes, segmented thumb, skeletons.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Buttons, fields, chips, segmented track, icon squares.

tokens.name: radius-lg
tokens.usage: Cards, category tiles, toasts, banners, the add button.

tokens.name: radius-sheet
tokens.usage: Top corners of bottom sheets only.

tokens.name: radius-full
tokens.usage: Only 8px person dots, avatars, the drag handle, progress ends.

shadow.note: Flat by default. Level 2 is the only shadow, and only in light; dark uses surface steps.

tokens.name: elevation-2
tokens.usage: Bottom sheets, toasts, tooltips, the bulk bar.

tokens.name: focus-ring
tokens.usage: Keyboard focus: a 2px surface gap, then 2px solid focus green (equivalent to outline 2px + offset 2px).

duration.note: Only sheets, toasts and segment changes move.

tokens.name: duration-sheet-in
tokens.usage: Bottom sheet enter.

tokens.name: duration-sheet-out
tokens.usage: Bottom sheet exit.

tokens.name: duration-toast
tokens.usage: Toast fade and 8px rise.

tokens.name: duration-segment
tokens.usage: Segmented thumb and month selection slide.

tokens.name: ease-out
tokens.usage: The only easing curve. Reduced motion: opacity only, 100ms.
